plane_groups.title: Control / truth plane
plane_groups.gloss: The DHT-notary: identity, commitments, attestations, reach. Source of truth; small, cheap, witnessed. Storage is a reconciliation controller OVER this plane (P1), never its owner.

plane_groups.title: Data plane
plane_groups.gloss: Actual byte/record movement: blobs, CRDT docs, shards, quilt RS(N,K). Where availability and durability live.

plane_groups.title: Projection plane
plane_groups.gloss: Read-optimized renders of truth for fast/legible access — storage SQLite projections (P2P side) and the doorway (web2 side). NEVER the source of truth.

plane_groups.title: Bridges (translation seam)
plane_groups.gloss: §3.6 lifted out of the plane grouping per the plan: a bridge translates an external protocol to/from the canonical substrate. It is a seam you ADD a crate at, not a participation track.

plane_groups.title: Governing / meta plane
plane_groups.gloss: The repo's own governance substrate — the .epr-meta policy family, the eprfs/cite-seal content-addressing family, CI/orchestrator, and the epr-cli/REA developer valueflow sidecar. It has no atlas §3 section because the atlas maps the RUNTIME; this column exists because C4, C5 and C7 have confirmed precedents here and C2's strongest precedent (the epr-cli append-order-vs-occurredAt replay) sits in the adjacent developer-tooling territory. A track-keyed axis would score all of those `n-a` when they are `unexamined`.

seams.name: Hardware / capability gradient
seams.plane_note: A device's capability_level is a DECLARED, witnessed fact (boot_registration writes it to the registry) — the operational envelope is derived from it. The derivation runs in the runtime, but the fact lives on the truth plane.

seams.name: Mod / plugin (native extension INTO the runtime)
seams.plane_note: Loading is a runtime act; INTEGRITY is a control-plane act — a plugin's effects route through the notary (bounds_validator + the delegates-compute Commitment + coordinator hot-swap). The atlas's own framing: "integrity comes from routing a plugin's effects through the notary".

seams.name: SDK grammar (compose inward — add a MANIFEST)
seams.plane_note: The four cheap moves (signal_kind, Commitment action, Governor impl, CoverageRollup predicate) are all control-plane vocabulary; integrity here is BY CONSTRUCTION, with no notary to route through.

seams.name: App-manifest / domain
seams.plane_note: The protocol-schema enums a domain manifest composes are DNA-notarized; the renderer map it also carries is projection vocabulary. Assigned to control because the notarized half is what a concern class can violate irrecoverably.

seams.name: Hub cluster ops + enablement (hub-INTERNAL swarm)
seams.plane_note: Leader election, pod consensus and replica/PVC placement are control decisions on a SECOND libp2p swarm, private to the hub — distinct from Track-2 hub-to-hub federation (§3.10/§3.11). Debugging blade consensus inside elohim-storage/src/p2p means the wrong crate.
seams.t1_routing: Identity-preserving tier graduation and DNA-key lineage route here (atlas §4: "Graduate hardware (laptop->NUC->rack) keeping identity | Hub enablement (3.12)"), which is why the identity-cross-signed forecast rung lands on this column despite being a T1 concern.

seams.name: Temporal / scheduling
seams.plane_note: Validity horizons and expiry->obligation are notarized facts; the durable scheduler that fires them is operational. The `time` substrate SIGNAL (economic, accounted) is a different thing from the scheduler and must not be conflated with it.

seams.name: OS / packaging / deploy target
seams.plane_note: Today this seam lives in CI and repo manifests (governing/meta-adjacent). Its DECLARED destination is the control plane — the declarative-desired-state rung has peers reconciling SIGNED desired state the way coordinators hot-swap. Assigned to its destination, with the today-state recorded here so the assignment is not read as a claim about the present. NO HABIT WATCHES THIS SEAM TODAY. `declarative-desired-state` was displaced from the register on 2026-08-13 (operator-directed) and is parked at `genesis/data/timeline/backlog/declarative-desired-state-parked-habit.md`; its stated return condition is a substrate precondition (the brit metadata plane / eprfs FUSE projection direction becoming testable), not a register slot. The link is removed rather than left dangling because a habits entry that resolves to nothing is a claim of observation where there is none — this seam's rung-proximity has been scoring at the "no linked habits article" floor the whole time regardless, so removing it changes no rank, only the honesty of the render. Re-link on the commit that returns the habit to `habits.yaml`.

seams.name: Runtime / binary + footprint
seams.plane_note: The single-node COMPOSITION axis (thin vs fat, cargo features, embedded children), orthogonal to network role. Same destination logic as §3.2: which composition a peer runs is desired state. Footprint tuning is native-binary-only — never per-device WASM/DNA (that moves the DNA hash and partitions the fleet). NO HABIT WATCHES THIS SEAM TODAY, for the same reason and on the same evidence as §3.2: `declarative-desired-state` is parked at `genesis/data/timeline/backlog/declarative-desired-state-parked-habit.md` since 2026-08-13. Re-link both seams on the commit that returns it to `habits.yaml`.

seams.name: Peer-hoster dataplane (Tracks 2 + 3)
seams.plane_note: Durable availability of records across disconnect. The head-election/notary side of the same record family is T1 (see t1_routing) — one column, two tracks, which is exactly why track is a cell ATTRIBUTE and not an axis.
seams.t1_routing: The content_store zome (select_canonical_winner, declare_canonical_head_inner) is the T1-notary/control side of this seam's record family and routes here, per the §4 "T1 notary floor (under 3.11)" precedent applied to content heads. The imagodei zome (agent/peer bindings, hosted-agent binding round-trips) routes here on the same precedent: its T1 records are the identity side of the record family this dataplane projects (peer_identity_bindings). shefa-types routes here as the shared commitment-terms predicates (same_commitment_metadata, validate_project_epr_current_terms) that the content_store coordinator and the native storage projection must agree on — one decision read from both sides of this seam.

seams.name: Aggregation / recursive rollup (Track 2)
seams.plane_note: Recursive signal aggregation over CoverageRollup plus the REA value-flow turning delegated compute into accounted flow, witnessed across DHT boundaries. A Case-A all-zeros bug here is a Track-1 identity-coherence failure wearing an aggregation costume — C0 before C-anything.

seams.name: Confidentiality / encryption / secrets
seams.plane_note: KeyEnvelope reader-key wraps ride the blob/quilt plane. Confidentiality is NOT integrity (T1 notary) and NOT authorization (§3.4): a notarized entry is world-readable, so "make this private" is this seam, never a permission flag.

seams.name: Resource governance / admission / backpressure
seams.plane_note: Guards ride the data AND projection planes (storage bounds_validator; doorway 503-shed; breakers); the unifying owner is the elohim-operator per-hub allocator, which is a control actor. Assigned to data because what it meters is byte/request flow.

seams.name: Client surface
seams.plane_note: Presentation + user-intent capture ONLY: render host-provided state, emit intent, bind nothing. Anything that looks like state ownership belongs to a doorway route, a zome coordinator, or a storage projection.

seams.name: Doorway projection (Track 4)
seams.plane_note: Makes canonical substrate truth legible to browsers and web2. The doorway is NOT a P2P participant — it never swarms libp2p or iroh. Bootstrap and signal consolidate here too.

seams.name: Bridge (translate outward — add a CRATE)
seams.plane_note: Imperative interop facing the non-elohim world. Not disjoint from §3.4: the bridge is the COMPILE-TIME instance of native extension; the discriminator is direction + bind-time.

seams.name: Governing / meta plane (repo's own governance substrate)
seams.plane_note: The .epr-meta policy family, the eprfs/cite-seal content-addressing family, CI/orchestrator, and the epr-cli/REA developer valueflow sidecar. Confirmed concern instances here: C7 (15 rules naming validators that do not exist, 2026-07-25), C5 (BlobCid::verifies hardcoding the wrong codec so self-verification was inert, 2026-07-24; and an unresolvable validator may not HARDEN an advisory rule, 2026-07-25), C4 (NOT_BUILT reading as 0 failures, CI museum #1), and C2's strongest precedent in the adjacent developer-tooling territory (the epr-cli/REA append-order-vs-occurredAt replay, a83b35079).

C0.title: Plane location — name the plane before binding any concern

C1.title: Anti-self-election — no component crowns what it authored

C10.title: Contract-evolution honesty — an unknown field is rejected or observed, never defaulted

C11.title: Externally-imposed backpressure — degrade by a declared, counted policy

C12.title: Consent/authorization (may-act) — authority verified structurally at the acting node

C13.title: Graduated authority — every scaffold names its successor at the gate

C14.title: Witnessed residual — the outcome set closes with an arm that is witnessed, never dropped

C2.title: C2 monotonic authority — never backwards, and name the clock

C3.title: Liveness — a legal move exists from every reachable state

C4.title: Honest absence — absent, unreachable, refused and unverifiable are distinct answers

C5.title: Evidence-not-authority (may-believe) — a claim confers only what the receiver re-derives

C6a.title: C6a bounded work — every loop, sweep and retry ladder respects a declared budget

C6b.title: Idempotent effect — replay against settled state mints nothing and double-applies nothing

C7.title: Advertise/serve symmetry — what a surface advertises equals what it serves

C8.title: Observability-per-decision — every outcome increments a labeled counter through a typed reason

C9.title: Identity-lineage continuity — a re-key never silently orphans state
